rules.justification: viscoelastic_maxwell: upstream operation order replicated (Voigt products through the coefficient-based order, sequential sums for the run-time-size branch energies and for the 3-D work expression whose cost exceeds Eigen's unrolling limit, glibc exp ported); bit-identical in upstream-compat mode (UD-029 reproduced); corrected defaults compared on the tangent and stiffness flags only.
rules.evidence: Measured in crates/akantu-solid/tests/material_fixtures_mat3.rs, debug build: 9,618 / 9,618 compat values (7 cases) and 2,856 / 2,856 corrected-default values (tangent, flags) bit-identical.
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
